repo.settings.dirHint: Leave empty to use the default directory from Local service settings.
repo.settings.autoMountHint: Mount this repository automatically when this machine starts; it is independent of whether it was mounted before and of other repositories.
repo.settings.saved: Mount settings saved for this repository
repo.mount.notMounted: This repository is not mounted on this machine, so it cannot be opened
repo.create.capacityHint: This is the repository **capacity** (nominal VHDX size); it is what the repository consumes from your quota. Quota itself is a per-user policy value, not a property of the repository.
user.quota.hint: Leave empty for unlimited (only the storage pool capacity applies); set it to cap this user's total usage across all repositories. Usage is counted automatically — you do not enter it
repo.assign.title: Assign to user
repo.release.confirm: Release this allocation? The diff disk will be deleted asynchronously.

repo.card.notReady: Repository is {state}; mounting is unavailable for now
repo.create.shareCountHint: How many diff disks and iSCSI targets (pool slots) to pre-create while the repository is built: disks handed out are ready to mount immediately instead of being created on demand. 0 = no pre-creation (the diff disk is derived at allocation time and the target is created during mount).
repo.create.shareCountExclusive: An exclusive repository has no diff disks: the disk itself is handed to the user and its iSCSI target is created together with it, so this field is not needed.
repo.quota.title: My quota
repo.quota.hint: Quota is user level: every repository you own draws from this single allowance.

user.enrollment.warning: The token cannot be viewed again after closing this dialog.
user.enrollment.maskedHint: The token is masked by default. Reveal it, copy it, and deliver it through a trusted channel.
user.certificates.title: User certificates
user.cert.privateKeyOnce: The private key is shown only once — download and hand it over now
user.cert.issueFailed: The user was created, but the certificate could not be issued
lease.revoked.hint: "Force offline" means the server stops serving and notifies the client to disconnect; it does not tear down the TCP session.
storage.title: Storage
storage.removeConfirm: Volumes created by the system are deleted with their data (unrecoverable); registered existing volumes are only unregistered. Continue?
storage.unmountConfirm: After unmounting, this storage no longer receives new disks and in-progress uploads are blocked; the data stays on the volume. Continue?
storage.resizeHint: Grow only — shrinking is not supported. The file system is expanded automatically.
storage.refHint: Device path of an existing LV, e.g. /dev/mapper/vg-lv. It is only mounted: never formatted, never deleted with the storage.
storage.refRequired: Please enter an existing volume reference
storage.mountPointAuto: Leave empty to auto-generate, e.g. /var/lib/vault/storages/<name>-<short id>.
storage.mountPointRequired: Registering an existing directory requires a mount point (absolute path).
storage.poolMissing: The LVM pool is not initialized yet. Initialize it in System settings → LVM pool first.
storage.pathLocked: Bound to a volume: the mount point cannot be changed. Remove and recreate it to relocate.
orphan.title: Orphan disks
orphan.subtitle: VHDX files under a storage root's disks directory that exist on disk but are not registered in the database. Reconciliation only reports them; clean them up here after your confirmation.
orphan.reconciledHint: These files usually come from a create/derive failing after writing the file but before committing the record, manual record deletion, or restoring the database to an earlier point in time. Reconciliation only reports them and never deletes automatically.
orphan.dangerHint: Deletion is irreversible: make sure no program is using the file and that it is not a differential or parent disk still in use.
orphan.summary: Scanned {checked} VHDX files; found {count} unregistered files, {size} in total.
orphan.checkedOnly: Scanned {checked} VHDX files; no unregistered files found.
orphan.sizeNote: Size is the logical file size; a sparse file may occupy less on disk.
orphan.kindHint.diff: Differential disks may hold user data; verify nobody is using it before deleting.
orphan.deleteConfirm: Delete this file? This cannot be undone.
orphan.emptyDesc: Every VHDX file under the storage roots is registered.
orphan.skipped: Some locations could not be scanned:
system.readonlyHint: The source of truth for these settings is the server's config.yaml. They are read-only here and cannot be changed online.
system.configHint: Version contract and runtime capabilities are read-only probes; server configuration can be edited online under "Server configuration" below (items that cannot be changed are greyed out with a reason).
system.config.title: Server configuration (all)
system.config.restartHint: Some of the changed settings only take effect after a restart: they have been written to the config file.
system.clientCompat.disabled: This server has disabled the client version range check
system.clientCompat.disabledWarn: Disabling the version check lowers protection; use it only for canary releases or troubleshooting.
system.rename.title: Change server display name
system.settings.overrideHint: This value comes from a runtime override (stored in the database).
system.lvm.title: LVM storage pool
system.lvm.hint: Virtual disks are backed by LVM thin logical volumes. Creating and extending the pool is done on the server command line; this page only shows the current state and offers a one-time initialization.
system.lvm.init.title: Initialize LVM storage pool
system.lvm.init.hint: This operation is idempotent: an existing volume group, thin pool and cache are skipped, never overwritten. Adding a cache rebuilds thin pool metadata and may take a while.
system.lvm.init.hddHint: Pick whole disks to hold virtual disks; ignored when the volume group already exists.
system.lvm.init.cacheHint: Pick SSDs as dm-cache to accelerate the data disks above; leave empty to disable caching.
system.lvm.init.cacheMode.writeBack: Writeback (faster, data loss risk on power failure)
system.lvm.device.name: Device
system.lvm.device.systemWarn: System disks are excluded automatically; reasons for other disabled devices are shown in the status column.
